title: Strike While the Fire Burns

source.quote: When the enemy is in great trouble, take the advantage the moment offers — the firm prevails over the yielding.

moral: Watch for the moment to move — a step early or a step late, and it is wasted.

story.title: The Best Troops Have Gone
story.text: Wu's best troops went north to a meeting, leaving only a few guards behind.
story.narration: King Fuchai of Wu took his best troops north to a meeting of lords, and only a few guards were left in the city. King Goujian of Yue stood by the river and watched for a long time — this was the window.

story.title: Away by Night
story.text: Yue's boats set out by night and finished the business before dawn.
story.narration: Yue's boats set out under cover of night and reached the walls of Wu before daybreak, and the business was done. Watch for the moment: a step early or a step late, and it is wasted.

keyMoment.question: When do we move?

options.hint: The guards have not gone far, and the gates are still shut tight.

options.text: Wait until Wu's best troops are far away

options.hint: Once the best troops come back, the window is shut — and the chance is gone.

keyMoment.reveal: Watch for the moment to move — a step early or a step late, and it is wasted.

misconceptions: Sooner is always better than later
Striking while the fire burns means grabbing what you can from someone's trouble

quiz.question: What did Yue wait for before it moved?
options: Wu's best troops had gone north to a meeting
Wu had mended its city gates
quiz.explanation: Wu's best troops had marched north, and the city was nearly empty — that was the window.

quiz.question: What does the Thirty-Six Stratagems say to do when the fire burns?
options: Take the advantage the moment offers
Attack head-on with your main force
Wait until the other side is ready
quiz.explanation: When the enemy is in great trouble, take the advantage the moment offers — that is the stratagem.

quiz.question: You want to finish your building blocks in peace. When is the best time?
options: When your little brother is busy with something else
When your little brother sits beside you watching
When your little brother has just woken up
quiz.explanation: When his attention is somewhere else — that is your window.
